sql: SELECT cls, count(*) n, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),2) pooled_ypa FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 32 AND 60 GROUP BY cls ORDER BY pooled_ypa DESC

SELECT cls, boat, count(*) n, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),2) pooled_ypa FROM trips WHERE fished_date_season=6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 46 AND 60 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter') GROUP BY cls, boat HAVING count(*)>=2 ORDER BY cls, pooled_ypa DESC
